interactives.label: Garden well
interactives.text: Cold water from the garden well.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: The moot's rule
interactives.text: What is made under the moot is made twice: once in the hands and once in the record. Work here teaches double.

interactives.label: Training post
interactives.text: The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Reading
interactives.text: A book read here reads three times as fast. Sit; the grove is patient.

interactives.label: Threads
interactives.text: Nine watchers face east. The grove reader says the scar is older than the fire, and that both have a beginning in the same season.

interactives.label: The hunt
interactives.text: A fox on the steppe, a crab in the delta, a rimeclaw in the range: the register's hunting chain, in that order.

interactives.label: Warm spring
interactives.text: The spring is warm and mineral; it restores you.

interactives.label: Butts
interactives.text: The butts list your recent combat results.

interactives.label: The arch
interactives.text: The great arch was raised over a road that no longer runs under it. The road ran east.

interactives.label: The ledger and the spore
interactives.text: Root's tally and the daybook count the same wagons. Where they differ is where somebody is standing.

interactives.label: The watchers
interactives.text: Nine stones, nine reasons. The eighth reason is that the fire must never be let out.

interactives.label: The Arch Reliquary
interactives.text: Sealed with resin, opened with resin: the arch's own reliquary.

interactives.label: Ward post
interactives.text: Nothing casts within these stones. The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Cistern
interactives.text: Rainwater from the cistern.

interactives.label: Breath
interactives.text: Rest here and the breath comes back twice as fast.

interactives.label: Storage
interactives.text: A wayfarer's cache beside every arrival opens the same storage as the civic chest. What you put in at one you take out at any.

sections.name: The Resin Hollow
sections.label: A hollow tree. The dark inside it goes down, not in.
sections.note: The old hollow tree is hollow all the way down. Resin weeps from the root walls.

sections.name: The Beekeeper's Under-Garden
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: Herbs the bees want, grown out of the wind. Sage and rosemary a step apart.

sections.name: The Charcoal Burner's Cache
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: A burner's cellar: coal by the sack, a bench, and a chest that opens your storage.

sections.name: The Moot Vault
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: The hall's own strongroom. The token of a stored account is the key it accepts.

sections.name: The Boar Run
sections.label: A knot of roots grown over a door frame.
sections.note: A coppice pit where the woodsmen pen boar for the young to learn on.

sections.name: The Grove Reader's School
sections.label: A hollow tree. The dark inside it goes down, not in.
sections.note: Where the grove reader keeps the books the moot would rather she did not.

sections.name: The Warm Spring
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: Behind the falls the rock is warm and the water in it heals.

sections.name: The Lookout Butts
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: A gallery under the lookout with straw butts and slow boar at the far end.

sections.name: The Arch Reliquary
sections.label: A shrine slab with fresh scratches where it has been slid aside.
sections.note: Sealed with resin, opened with resin: the arch's own reliquary.

sections.name: The Stone Ring Well
sections.label: A cairn built over nothing, or over something.
sections.note: Inside the ring nothing casts. The wolves penned below do not care.

sections.name: The Wayshrine Focus
sections.label: A shrine slab with fresh scratches where it has been slid aside.
sections.note: Under the wayshrine the ether pools; a spell costs half here.

sections.name: The Undercut
sections.label: A knot of roots grown over a door frame.
sections.note: A charcoal burners' tunnel under the boundary, out onto the moors.

sections.name: The Amber Waystone
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: Four stones for four roads. An iron rune wakes them.

sections.name: The Kelp Landing Eyrie
sections.label: An arch so grown with vine it reads as hedge.
sections.note: A cliff pocket over the landing where the kelp cutters rest.

secrets.note: Each section is one secret. The client shows a player only the section they stand in; the server places the arrival, the areas, the spawns and the harvest nodes from this block.

provenance.geometry: authored with the secret rooms kit over the shared toolkit

notes: 14 secrets of Amberwood Secrets on one map with void between them; which one a player gets is which feature of the ground above they used.
